description:
Add a long-term memory record to a PC (the character pipeline creates only PCs). Use at creation if the backstory/playerRequest contains key events that should affect the narrative of future turns: the trauma of losing a family, a vow, a curse, an unpaid debt, an important meeting.

        |`memoryTextId` — always NEW: an existing id is rejected (to refine the same record — `updateMemory`).

        |Types: EVENT/RELATIONSHIP/OBLIGATION/KNOWLEDGE/REPUTATION/QUEST (see MemoryType). **IMPRESSION is not allowed for a PC** — this type is for NPCs only and will return an error. **`directive` is not allowed for a PC** — a PC is controlled by a live player, not by the system, so a behavioral stance makes no sense; always null for a PC.

        |Fields:
        |- `fact` — what happened objectively.
        |- `context` — the personal meaning for the character.
        |- `importance` — LOW/NORMAL/HIGH.
name: addMemory

type.description: Memory type. IMPRESSION is not allowed for a PC.

fact.description: Objective fact of what happened (no emotions). At least 20 characters.

context.description: Personal value for the character: emotions, assessment, secrecy.

atRound.description: Round number of the event. For backstory/events before the game starts — 0 (default). The character pipeline creates the character BEFORE round 0, so usually `atRound=0`.

subjectTextId.description: Optional: textId of the character the record is about (for example, for RELATIONSHIP — who this person is). Used only for UI grouping.

links.description: Optional: typed links to other memory records of the same character. RELATES_TO — general; CLOSES — closes (target → OUTDATED); EXTENDS — continues.

targetTextId.description: textId of the target memory record of the SAME character (the record must already exist).

type.description: Link type: RELATES_TO — a general association; CLOSES — closes the target (it automatically becomes OUTDATED); EXTENDS — continues/develops the target.

closesTaskId.description: Optional. ID of the task or issue that is FULLY resolved by THIS call — pass it OPTIMISTICALLY when you are confident in the arguments. If the call returns an error, the wrapper itself will NOT close the task. Don't use it for partial progress; for multi-tool tasks, close via completeTask after the final step.

description: Record a new task for yourself as a result of self-review. Available ONLY in the SELF_REVIEW phase. After adding all tasks call transitionTo into the working phase — the frame will execute them there.
name: addTask

description.description: What exactly needs to be done

description: Mark the task as done. Use this tool after you have performed all the actions described in the task or fixed the problem found by the setter.
name: completeTask

reason.description: Optional: closing reason/comment. Required for "decision items" of the checklist (for example, refusing a book promotion): such an item is closed by a SEPARATE call with an explicit reason, not silently in a common batch.

description: Mark several tasks as done in one call. Use for going through the working phase's checklist in a row (for example, closing several 'chk-*' items) when there are no intermediate decisions between them. If an idea appears along the way — close them one by one via completeTask. REVIEW items ('rev-*', the self-check phase) are NOT closed by this tool: each requires a separate completeTask with a verdict-specific in reason, batch closing is rejected.
name: completeTasks

ids.description: List of task IDs to close

description: Soft-delete a memory by textId — sets status=DELETED, does not delete physically. Undo — `updateMemory(status=ABANDONED)`; if the understanding of the character changed — close the record (`OUTDATED`) and write a new one with `addMemory` under a new textId. Use only if the record was created by mistake.
name: removeMemory

closesTaskId.description: Optional. ID of the task or issue that is FULLY resolved by THIS call — pass it OPTIMISTICALLY when you are confident in the arguments. If the call returns an error, the wrapper itself will NOT close the task. Don't use it for partial progress; for multi-tool tasks, close via completeTask after the final step.

description: Transition to another state (phase) of work. Call it once the current phase's work is complete — as the LAST call of the SAME response that finishes that work (when the phase rules allow the transition). The switch is applied at the END of this response: every other call in the same response still runs in the CURRENT phase, so it is safe to finish the phase's work and request the transition together. Do not spend a separate response on a lone transition call, and do not place new work AFTER the transition expecting the new phase.
name: transitionTo

alignment.description: D&D alignment — only the adapted title, without the original in a foreign language in parentheses.

description:
Update an existing memory. Use for:
        |- Refining the fact/context of the same record. If the understanding changed per the plot — not here: close the record (`OUTDATED`) and write a new one via `addMemory` under a new textId.
        |- **Fixing a wrongly chosen type (`type`).** Changing `type` is only a fix of a selection mistake: the record described from the very beginning the same thing as now, and the type was chosen wrongly. If the record became different because something happened after it (a rumor was confirmed, a meeting grew into a relationship, a secret gave rise to a vow, an act changed the attitude of those around), — that is a new understanding: close the old one (`OUTDATED`) and write a new one of the right type via `addMemory` under a new id. The test — compare with the moment of writing: a type that was correct **at the moment of writing** differs from the recorded one — this is a selection mistake, fix it with `updateMemory`. The type was correct at the moment of writing but became wrong because of **subsequent** events — this is a new memory via `addMemory`. **IMPRESSION is not allowed for a PC** — the character pipeline creates only PCs.
        |- **Status changes (`status` + `outcome`)** when a task/obligation ends: COMPLETED/FAILED/ABANDONED/OUTDATED.
name: updateMemory

type.description: New memory type — only to fix a selection mistake (see the tool description). IMPRESSION is not allowed for a PC.

status.description: New status (ACTIVE/COMPLETED/FAILED/ABANDONED/OUTDATED/DELETED). When changing to a final one — be sure to give an outcome. DELETED = soft-delete.

outcome.description: Short description of the outcome — filled in together with the final status.

subjectTextId.description: New subjectTextId (textId of the character the record is about), if it changes.

addLinks.description: Add new links. CLOSES in this list automatically OUTDATEs the target.

targetTextId.description: textId of the target memory record of the SAME character (the record must already exist).

description: Give a verdict on EVERY item of the self-check checklist from the phase description: the item id, ok=true if satisfied, otherwise ok=false and what is wrong in problem. Call AFTER the last completeTask, last in the response — without a valid selfCheck the work will not complete.
name: selfCheck
